messages:
Olivia Chen: Heads up — I pulled the ownership heatmap for last 7 days. There's a cluster of unclaimed leads between 9-11am PST every weekday.
Jordan Patel: that's the heavy ingestion window from marketing webinars, right? :thinking_face:
Olivia Chen: yeah — looks like the RR rotation isn't keeping up during bursts. Claim latency spikes to ~6m.
Samir Gupta: 6m is killer for SLA. Is that across all hubspot owners or specific pools?
Olivia Chen: mostly AM rotation pool (growth_reps). Secondary pools less affected.
Mia Torres: do we have any debounce/claim-throttle in the new HubSpot workflow? I thought we added a 30s claim lock.
Jordan Patel: we do, but it only protects duplicate claims, not rate across the queue. We need per-owner rate limits + backlog offload.
Lead Sync Bot: notice: 185 leads failed enrichment in last 2h — retry scheduled in 15m.
Taylor Reed: can we backfill enrichment on a lower-priority worker and temporarily widen RR batch size? maybe 10 -> 25 during bursts.
Samir Gupta: increasing batch size will help throughput but increases time-to-first-claim. tradeoff needs modelling.
Olivia Chen: sketched a quick config change: set round_robin_batch=25 for morning-window and enable overflow queue to 'triage_pool'.
Jordan Patel: can you drop the exact CLI we would run? makes it easier for eng to prod it.
Olivia Chen: sure — example:
```
hubspot-sync set --pool growth_reps --rr-batch 25 --overflow-queue triage_pool --claim-lock 30s
```
Mia Torres: + add a metric for 'claim_time_p95_by_hour' so we can validate.
Taylor Reed: I'll add the metric to Grafana and create an alert for >2m p95 during 9-11am.
Samir Gupta: also propose a quick backfill job for the 185 failed enrichment leads: run with lower concurrency and enrichment_cache=true.
Lead Sync Bot: ack: scheduled backfill job id job_2026_03_21_01
Olivia Chen: plan: 1) toggle rr-batch for morning window, 2) start backfill, 3) add metric & alert. Want a 5pm check-in today.
Jordan Patel: SGTM. @Taylor @Samir can you own steps 2 & 3?
Taylor Reed: assigned. will post PR and dashboard link when ready.
Samir Gupta: I'll coordinate the backfill and validate duplicates are avoided.
Mia Torres: I'll update the SLA doc: set expected claim_time p95 target to 90s for morning window and note the fallback procedure.
Olivia Chen: thanks team. tagging @leadops for visibility :eyes: 
Lead Sync Bot: reminder: next maintenance window tomorrow 02:00-03:00 UTC.
Taylor Reed: quick followup — PR: https://github.com/redwood/lead-sync/pull/412
Jordan Patel: excellent, will review.
Olivia Chen: end-of-thread — we'll reconvene 5pm to confirm metrics. :rocket:
